For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, realistic phone-mirror selfie footage, a medium shot framing her from the top of her head down to just above the knees, feet out of frame, inside a warm-toned modern apartment in the early afternoon. The woman in <Picture 1> is the only subject, and the shot opens on exactly the state of that picture: her right hand, which appears on the left side of the frame, holds the back of the rose-gold phone at chest height, while her left hand, which appears on the right side of the frame, touches the temple of her black square sunglasses, a faint closed-lip smile, weight even on both legs; her appearance and position stay identical to the reference — dark-blonde low bun, gold hoop earrings, black wide pop-art-print T-shirt over the white long-sleeve layer, red-and-black plaid drawstring trousers, chain-strap quilted bag hanging at the left of her hip, against the warm grey wall with the black-and-white artwork, the black low cabinet with the lit mushroom lamp, and the black-framed window with white venetian blinds. The camera holds a static shot and the take is continuous with no cut. Movement starts at once: her fingertips slide down the sunglasses temple and press the frame a little lower, her eyes lift over the lenses into the mirror, her eyebrows rise and her smile widens, then her weight shifts onto one leg and her hip swings slightly out into a posed stance. The clear, playful young woman (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 镜子里这位——今天状态不错啊！</d> She pushes the sunglasses back up to the bridge of her nose and lets her shoulders settle. No on-screen text or watermark appears.

overall_soundscape: Quiet apartment room tone with a soft fabric rustle, a light shift of weight on the wooden floor and faint street sound beyond the window. Her voice is dry, close and free of reverb.

non_diegetic_music: Warm fashion lo-fi R&B at about 90 BPM, soft electric piano and finger snaps under a restrained mix, with one light accent landing at the end of the line.

---

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 2> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, realistic phone-mirror selfie footage, a close shot framing her from the top of the head to the hips in the same apartment, the lit mushroom lamp and the framed artwork soft behind her. This segment starts from the state of <Picture 2> itself, not from the last frame of the previous segment: the rose-gold phone is held low and stays out of the frame, her right hand, which appears on the left side of the frame, rests a fingertip on the temple of her black square sunglasses, her head tips slightly toward that hand and a wide warm smile reaches the mirror; visible here: dark-blonde low bun, gold hoop earrings, the colourful pop-art print on the black T-shirt with the white long-sleeve cuffs, and the chain-strap quilted bag in front of her hip. The camera pushes straight in toward her face slowly at constant speed and the take is continuous with no cut. Movement starts at once: she presses the sunglasses down to the middle of her nose bridge, looks straight into the mirror over the lenses, lifts one eyebrow and lets the smile open wider, her shoulders lift once and the gold hoop catches a small highlight. The clear young woman (S1) says with a smile in her voice: <d>[Chinese] 墨镜一戴——谁都不爱。</d> She pushes the sunglasses back into place, chin slightly lifted. No on-screen text or watermark appears.

overall_soundscape: A faint scrape of fingertip on the frame, cloth rustle and quiet room tone underneath. Her breath is light and her voice sits close and forward.

non_diegetic_music: The same 90 BPM bed continues, finger snaps settling into a full pattern, the bass rising, and one light synth glide landing on the moment the sunglasses come down.

---

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 3> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, realistic mirror-selfie footage, an extreme close-up in the same apartment: the back of the rose-gold phone with its clear case, Apple logo and triple camera module fills the centre of the frame, gripped by both hands with both white long-sleeve cuffs showing; her face stays out of the frame with only a sliver of the black sunglasses and her chin at the top right edge, warm sunlight through the white venetian blinds on the left and a blurred framed artwork behind. This segment starts from the state of <Picture 3> itself, not from the last frame of the previous segment. The camera holds a static shot and the take is continuous with no cut. Movement starts at once: she keeps the phone steady for the first second, then slides it a hand's width sideways to open a narrow gap that shows her chin and a rising smile, snaps it back to cover her face again, her shoulders shake with held-back laughter and her fingertips tap twice on the phone case. The clear young woman (S1) says, playful and close: <d>[Chinese] 嘘——好戏，先卖个关子。</d> A soft laugh slips out from behind the phone as the movement settles. No on-screen text or watermark appears.

overall_soundscape: Light taps of a fingertip on a phone case, fabric shifting and low room tone. The voice comes out clearly from above the phone with a suppressed laugh underneath it.

non_diegetic_music: The beat holds, a playful electronic pluck answers the line in call-and-response, bright but never covering the voice, with the groove tightening toward the end.

---

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, realistic close footage in the same apartment, a close shot on her head and shoulders: her head tips down toward the rose-gold phone held in both hands at face height, her gaze lowered onto the screen behind the black square sunglasses, the back of the phone angled toward the lens with the triple camera module partly readable, her expression calm and a little languid, gold hoop earrings, dark-blonde low bun, the pop-art print and white long-sleeve cuffs visible at the bottom of the frame, the chain strap of the quilted bag over her shoulder, warm afternoon sun patches on the wall and the lit mushroom lamp blurred behind. This segment starts from the state of <Picture 4> itself, not from the last frame of the previous segment. The camera pushes straight in slowly at constant speed and the take is continuous with no cut. Movement starts at once: her thumb taps the screen twice, the corners of her mouth begin to lift, her head rises slowly and she looks over the top of the sunglasses with one eyebrow arched in approval, then turns the phone slightly toward the glass to show the screen. The clear young woman (S1) says, steady and assured: <d>[Chinese] 让我看看……嗯，无可挑剔。</d> The corner of her mouth curls and she settles back down toward the screen. No on-screen text or watermark appears.

overall_soundscape: Soft taps on the screen, cloth moving and the quiet room tone of a sunlit apartment. The voice is clean and forward.

non_diegetic_music: The groove is fully formed now, hand claps and bass moving together with light trap-style hi-hat rolls, and a crisp accent closes on the last word.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, realistic mirror-selfie footage, a medium shot framing her from the top of the head to mid-thigh in the same apartment, the black low cabinet and the lit mushroom lamp on the left of the frame and the black-framed window on the right. This segment starts from the state of <Picture 5> itself, not from the last frame of the previous segment: she stands three-quarter to the mirror, the rose-gold phone raised at face height in her left hand, which appears on the right side of the frame with her gaze lowered onto the screen over the top of it, black square sunglasses, dark-blonde low bun, gold hoop earrings, pop-art print T-shirt over the white long sleeve, red-and-black plaid drawstring trousers, the chain-strap quilted bag hanging on the left side of the frame. The camera holds a static shot and the take is continuous with no cut. Movement starts at once: her eyes travel from the screen up into the mirror, her free hand on the left gives the quilted bag a small outward lift and lets it drop back into place, her hip rolls into a side pose and the drawstring of the trousers swings with the movement, chin raised. The clear young woman (S1) says, pleased with herself: <d>[Chinese] 侧面也没毛病——包是点睛之笔。</d> She nods once at herself in the mirror, satisfied. No on-screen text or watermark appears.

overall_soundscape: Light friction of chain and leather, plaid fabric swinging, a weight shift on the wooden floor and distant street sound. The voice stays clean and close.

non_diegetic_music: The track peaks here, drums, bass and finger snaps together under a bright synth chord, landing a strong hit just after the line and holding.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, realistic mirror-selfie footage, a medium-full shot framing her from the top of the head to the shins, feet out of frame, in the same apartment, warm sunlight streaking diagonally across the wall beside the black-framed window. This segment starts from the state of <Picture 6> itself, not from the last frame of the previous segment: her left arm, which appears on the right side of the frame and wears the white long sleeve, is raised straight up with the rose-gold phone well above shoulder height and its back to the mirror, her gaze lifted onto the screen behind the black sunglasses, chin up; the other arm hangs loose at the left side of the frame with the chain-strap quilted bag, dark-blonde low bun, gold hoop earrings, pop-art print T-shirt over the white long sleeve, red-and-black plaid drawstring trousers. The camera pushes straight in slowly at constant speed and the take is continuous with no cut. Movement starts at once: her free hand comes up onto her hip and the hip pushes out into a closing pose, she makes a quick half turn in place and comes back with the bag and the plaid trousers swinging, chin still raised and the smile bright; in the final second she lowers the phone to shoulder height and waves lightly at the mirror as the frame settles almost still. The clear young woman (S1) says, bright and easy: <d>[Chinese] 收工！镜头感这东西——天生的。</d> A light laugh follows. No on-screen text or watermark appears.

overall_soundscape: Cloth swinging through the turn, the light rattle of the chain bag, a weight shift on the floorboards and faint traffic outside. The voice is clear with a small laugh at the end.

non_diegetic_music: The track closes on a single bright chord, the beat dropping out so only two finger snaps and a synth tail fade under the laugh.

**① 分段秒数 / 总时长**
- 几段提示词就写几个数字：本工作流 6 张图 = 6 段 × 5 秒 → `5,5,5,5,5,5`（单段 4–15 秒，最多 30 段）。
- `seconds` 是整条时间线总上限，要比各段之和留 1–2 秒余量。当前填 30 = 刚好等于 6×5，末段可能被压尾，建议改成 31–32。
- 提示词用**单独一行 `---`** 分段；**段数 = 秒数个数 = 参考图片张数**，缺一段就会报错。
